# PairTalk

> PairTalk is an autonomous peer-to-peer IELTS Speaking preparation platform operating natively on Telegram and the Web. It connects English learners worldwide in under 3 seconds based on target band scores (Band 5–9) and official IELTS criteria (Fluency, Vocabulary, Grammar, Pronunciation) for live Part 1, 2, and 3 practice sessions inside encrypted WebRTC voice rooms.

## Core Documentation
- [How It Works](https://pairtalk.online/how-it-works): Matchmaking radar, band scoring criteria calibration, and room simulation workflow.
- [IELTS Speaking Guide](https://pairtalk.online/ielts-speaking): Detailed breakdown of IELTS Speaking Part 1 interview, Part 2 cue cards, Part 3 discussions, and band descriptors.
- [Pricing](https://pairtalk.online/#pricing): Comparison of Free tier and paid accelerator plans (Plus, Pro, Boss) with audio recording retention limits.
- [FAQ](https://pairtalk.online/faq): Verbatim answers on partner matching, audio requirements, privacy protections, and money-back guarantee.
- [Safety & Etiquette](https://pairtalk.online/community-guidelines): Candidate code of conduct, anti-harassment policies, moderation ladder, and unban appeal procedures.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pairtalk.online/privacy): Audio retention schedules, zero-knowledge PII safeguards, and refund policy terms.
